PRACTICE

Chose 5 distances. Make one putt from each spot backing up after throw. Each putt made is 1 pt, double if you make them all (max 10 pts/round). First player to 21 wins. Must win by 2 at the end of each round. 


PRESSURE

Grab 5 putters and pick 3 distances. Start each round at the shortest distance from the basket. If you make the putt backup, if you miss move forward. PLAY

Alternate picking a different spot each round and make 2 putts each in a row. Players get 1 pt for 1 putt made and 3 pts for 2 putts made. First player to 21 wins. Must win by 2 at the end of the round. 


WINNING

Start with 5 putters at any distance and putt them all. Each missed putt is out of the game. Back up after each round and throw the remaining putters. Last person with a disc left wins! If everyone is out in the same round from the same spot, start again with all 5 putters.
